lines: You can't turn it *off*. Not even to sleep.
At lunch, your friend takes ten seconds to say one sentence. So you finish it for him. Then the next one. Then he stops talking.
At night, your brain counts every atom in the ceiling. Three nights now... *no sleep*.
Then Mo says it, very quietly: you're scaring me. You calculate his heartbeat. It's fast. You didn't even need to.
And now, at three in the morning... *who* is knocking on your door?
Follow and comment... for part three!
